changelog: - **The Review dialog now behaves like every other dialog for keyboard and screen-reader use.** On a computer, Review did not take focus when it opened, Tab could walk out of it into the toolbar and the canvas behind it, and the page behind stayed reachable. Now focus moves into Review, Tab stays inside it, the page behind is out of reach until it closes, and with the confirmation to replace the open diagram on top of Review, Escape closes the confirmation first.
